estimates.assumptions: 1 tbls sunflower oil = 14 g; all oil is used in frying, with modest absorption accounted for in total recipe contribution
225 g paneer (standard Indian fresh cheese); values reflect typical full-fat paneer nutrition for the entire quantity
2 thumb-sized pieces of fresh ginger ≈ 20 g total; peeled and used in paste
1 tsp whole or ground cumin seeds ≈ 2 g; entire quantity contributes to recipe
1 tsp ground turmeric ≈ 3 g; entire quantity contributes to recipe
1 tsp ground coriander ≈ 2 g; entire quantity contributes to recipe
1 medium green chilli ≈ 15 g; entire fresh chilli contributes to recipe
4 large tomatoes (≈ 800 g total raw weight); mashed and cooked down, using edible flesh only
150 g green peas (fresh or frozen); entire quantity used as-is
1 tsp garam masala ≈ 2 g; entire spice blend quantity contributes to recipe
small bunch fresh coriander leaves ≈ 15 g; entire quantity as garnish
naan bread 'to serve' is not a fixed recipe quantity; cannot estimate without specified number or weight
